visualCharacteristics: A horizontal row of numbered process steps. Each step shows a circular number badge followed by a short label. Steps sit side by side on desktop and stack vertically on mobile.
contentPattern: One cell per step (either a single row with N cells, or N single-cell rows). Each cell holds the step's short label text. Step numbers are generated automatically in document order.
usage: Use for a 'How it works' style sequence of ordered steps.
